description: RYOBI introduces the 95-Piece Drilling and Drive Kit. This assortment of drilling and impact bits include a large variety fit for all projects including wood, metal, plastic, brick, block, concrete, and mortar materials. The Black Oxide bits are constructed out of high-speed steel with a black oxide finish to offer superior durability. Another key detail of these bits is the 135° split point that prevents your bit from walking and ensures drilling on contact. This kit features bits containing a TORSION ZONE that is engineered to absorb the high torque and demand that comes with the use of an impact driver for 3X longer life. The 3.5 in. bits are perfect for extended driving capability in hard-to-reach applications. The woodboring spade bits, ranging from 1/2 in. to 1 in., are perfect for fast, clean and accurate drilling. Also included are (5) bradpoint drill bits to improve precision for clean wood drilling. This kit includes 5 masonry bits compatible with your hammer drill, rotary hammer or impact driver for all your brick, block, concrete and mortar needs. The nut drivers feature a powerful fastening that provide excellent end results. This set includes (20) Black Oxide Drill and Drive Bits, (5) masonry drill bits, (4) wordboring spade bits, (6) bradpoint drill bits, (41) 1 in. impact drive bits, (9) 2 in. impact drive bits, (3) 3 1/2 in. impact drive bits, (6) impact nut drivers, (1) impact magnetic bit holder, and a clear front carrying case.
